fusions.name: Slab Heave
fusions.desc: Hurls a slab of rock that deals 16 damage and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Bastion Breaker
fusions.desc: Brings a wall-sized slab down on the target, dealing 36 damage and ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Granite Rampart
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 30 damage for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 15% while it holds.

fusions.name: Counterweight
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
